verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own KB documents routing all internet traffic through a specific device on your network. A hands-on community report confirms a user ran an exit node on a home Apple TV and routed a GitHub Actions worker through it successfully. missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation (advertising/approving an exit node, selecting it per client/platform), and a first-party snippet that explicitly names the exit node feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node

citations.quote: Route all internet traffic through a specific device on your network.
The user ran an exit node on an Apple TV at home and routed the Actions worker through it. 'Worked great!'
